mapper.select: select pair_id from dating_pair where user_low_id in (#{low},#{high}) or user_high_id in (#{low},#{high}) order by pair_id
mapper.sql: from dating_success_case c join dating_pair p on p.pair_id=c.pair_id join dating_success_case_member l on l.case_id=c.case_id and l.user_id=p.user_low_id join dating_success_case_member h on h.case_id=c.case_id and h.user_id=p.user_high_id join sys_paying_user lu on lu.id=p.user_low_id join sys_paying_user hu on hu.id=p.user_high_id left join sys_user ls on ls.user_id=lu.matchmaker_id left join sys_user hs on hs.user_id=hu.matchmaker_id

sql.if: and ((case when lu.matchmaker_id is null then lu.create_by else ls.user_name end)=#{owner} or (case when hu.matchmaker_id is null then hu.create_by else hs.user_name end)=#{owner})
and (l.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or h.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: select where 1=1 order by c.success_at desc,c.case_id desc
select count(distinct c.case_id) as case_count,count(distinct m.user_id) as people_count join dating_success_case_member m on m.case_id=c.case_id where 1=1

select m.matchmaker_id,max(m.matchmaker_name) as matchmaker_name join dating_success_case_member m on m.case_id=c.case_id where m.matchmaker_id is not null group by m.matchmaker_id order by m.matchmaker_id
select user_id,user_name,matchmaker_id,matchmaker_name,retained_times from dating_success_case_member where case_id=#{id} order by user_id
select note,evidence from dating_success_case where case_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into dating_success_case_member(case_id,user_id,user_name,matchmaker_id,matchmaker_name,retained_times) select #{caseId},u.id,u.name,u.matchmaker_id,s.nick_name, (select coalesce(sum(e.remaining_times),0) from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id and e.status in ('ACTIVE','EXHAUSTED')) from sys_paying_user u left join sys_user s on s.user_id=u.matchmaker_id where u.id=#{userId}
mapper.update: update dating_entitlement set status='SUCCESS_CLOSED' where user_id=#{userId} and status in ('ACTIVE','EXHAUSTED')
update dating_order set status='CANCELLED',cancel_reason=#{reason},update_by=#{actor},update_time=current_timestamp where user_id=#{userId} and status='UNPAID'
update dating_pair_participant set deduct_status='STOPPED',blocked_reason=#{reason} where pair_id=#{pairId} and deduct_status<>'DEDUCTED'
update dating_deduction_task set status='CANCELLED',outcome='STOPPED' where pair_id=#{pairId} and status in ('READY','ERROR')
